races.paceDynamic: Son Of Wind is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gate, likely getting an uncontested lead through moderate early fractions. An Laochmor, Sovereign Banter, Snowballs and Rattletheonionbag will press forward into prominent positions, but none are aggressive enough to seriously challenge Son Of Wind's supremacy early. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Oxford Circus, Winemaker, Jered Maddox, Rough Diamond, Hot To Foxtrot and Cooee Call will be dependent on the pace collapsing in the final furlong. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader without being too far back, as they can respond to any acceleration while the hold-up brigade faces a wall of horses ahead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind sets honest but not suicidal pace
scenarios.body: The prominent trackers get first run on the leader and can kick clear before the hold-up horses can organise their challenges. An Laochmor and Sovereign Banter are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind gets soft sectionals and conserves energy for sustained finish
scenarios.body: The leader exploits his uncontested advantage and has enough left to repel late challenges from a strong position. Son Of Wind's stamina reserves prove decisive against horses coming from too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in final two furlongs creating gaps
scenarios.body: Oxford Circus and Winemaker find racing room to unleash their finishing kicks against tiring leaders. The race becomes a sprint finish where class and fresh legs matter most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Weak Pace Suits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind goes too slowly and field bunches up dramatically
scenarios.body: Rattletheonbag's 13lb weight advantage becomes telling in a messy sprint finish where positioning matters more than class. The race becomes a lottery favouring horses drawn well.

watchPoints.text: Watch Son Of Wind's early sectionals as uncontested leader could steal significant advantage through soft fractions

Observe Sovereign Banter's response to top weight burden in final furlong despite 7lb claiming allowance

races.paceDynamic: Real Encounter will take the field along as the sole recognized front runner, setting a comfortable tempo without early pressure. The lack of other pace angles means he'll get an uncontested lead through steady fractions. With most rivals adopting hold-up tactics (Aughlish, Meriden, Allsortz, Atallah), the pace will be pedestrian early before quickening late. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and any horse that can track close early, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of traffic in the sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Real Encounter gets soft fractions and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: Real Encounter will control from flag to finish with no early pressure, then have enough left to repel late challengers. His proven front-running style at this trip makes him hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unknowns tracks Real Encounter early
scenarios.body: Beach Barbie or Hinder could sit second/third, avoiding the traffic that will engulf the hold-up horses. Their higher ratings suggest class advantage if positioned right.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Weaves Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and gaps appear late
scenarios.body: Allsortz has the best recent form of the hold-up brigade and has shown ability at this trip. A slow pace could set up his finishing kick if he finds racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Real Encounter goes too slow and stops
scenarios.body: The entire field could come with late runs, creating a messy finish where any horse could prevail. This chaotic scenario suits the lightly-raced newcomers most.

watchPoints.text: Real Encounter could get uncontested fractions and prove hard to pass despite his long absence
Traffic problems likely in straight as multiple hold-up horses seek racing room simultaneously
Beach Barbie's debut running style will indicate if she can avoid the hold-up scrum
Hinder represents powerful Lyons stable and Keane booking suggests confidence in newcomer
Allsortz carries penalty but has best recent form of the hold-up brigade if finding clear run

races.paceDynamic: Private Larry and Straight Back Up will contest the early lead, though both have shown tendencies to fade in the finish which could set up a perfect scenario for closers. With Royal County Glory likely to press from a prominent position, the pace should be honest but not destructively fast given the limited early speed. The majority of the field consists of hold-up horses who will be looking to pounce in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up brigade who can capitalise on the expected pace collapse from the front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is honest but the leaders fade as expected in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up horses will be rewarded as they sweep past tiring leaders. Horses with strong finishing kicks will have plenty to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Royal County Glory can settle closer to the pace without getting involved in early battles
scenarios.body: The 3-year-old can use his tactical speed to bridge the gap between pace-setters and hold-up horses. His recent form suggests he's ready to strike at this level.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Shock Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Private Larry or Straight Back Up can find improved stamina and the pace is more sedate than expected
scenarios.body: One of the leaders manages to defy their fading tendencies and holds on grimly. The hold-up horses leave their run too late or get caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders fade dramatically and the prominent runners also struggle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery as all the hold-up horses come with late runs simultaneously. The winner emerges from a blanket finish based purely on who gets the clearest passage.

races.paceDynamic: Jawhary will lead this race from the start with his prominent style, creating a sustainable but uncontested early pace given the lack of other natural front runners. The packed field of hold-up horses including Desert Friend, Slowdownbarney, and Sarmiento Power will settle behind, creating a compressed group waiting to pounce. Expert Analysis may track closer as the only other prominent runner but lacks recent form confidence. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish, as they'll have plenty of pace to aim at and Jawhary's solitary lead may not be strong enough to resist late challengers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their runs perfectly in the final 2f
scenarios.body: Desert Friend and Sarmiento Power benefit most from tracking the modest pace before unleashing finishing kicks that Jawhary cannot match. The patient tactics pay dividends as the leader weakens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Jawhary's uncontested lead proves too valuable and the chasers leave it too late
scenarios.body: The leader builds an insurmountable advantage while the hold-up brigade hesitate, with only Expert Analysis able to get close enough to threaten. Jawhary's recent wins show he can sustain his effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Jawhary sets too slow a pace and multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where the best-handicapped horses with recent form like Celtic Druid and Fine Print can capitalise. The lack of early pace creates chaos in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the main fancies are poorly positioned when the pace quickens
scenarios.body: Grey Fable or Mephisto, both returning from breaks but proven at the distance, time their moves to perfection while others are caught in traffic. Their fresh legs prove decisive.

races.paceDynamic: With A Pretty Penny now a non-runner, only Ramair remains as a confirmed front-runner, likely to take them along at a steady pace without serious early pressure. The five hold-up horses (Keepsgettingbetter, Elm Creek, Musashi, Cameclose, Sea Of Dubka) will all be looking to come from behind over this 1m2½f trip. This creates a tactical scenario where Ramair could steal a march if the pace becomes too sedate, but more likely sets up perfectly for the closers who can time their runs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves steady and Ramair doesn't kick clear early enough
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get perfect conditions to unleash finishing kicks, with Keepsgettingbetter and Elm Creek best positioned to capitalize. Multiple closers converge in the final furlong with the strongest stayers prevailing.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Ramair Steals March
scenarios.trigger: If Ramair gets uncontested fractions and builds an unassailable lead
scenarios.body: Without early pace pressure, the front-runner can dictate terms and kick clear when the closers are still organizing their challenges. The hold-up horses find too much ground to make up despite their finishing efforts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes extremely slow with all runners waiting
scenarios.body: The race develops into a sprint finish where tactical positioning matters more than stamina, suiting those with natural pace. Elm Creek and Keepsgettingbetter can quicken best when the race explodes late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Ramair Folds Early
scenarios.trigger: If Ramair stops quickly after making the running and creates a muddled race
scenarios.body: The front-runner's collapse leaves no clear pace angle, creating a messy finish where any of the hold-up horses could emerge. Form and class become the deciding factors rather than tactics.
